answer: A concrete sybil brake is a bonded first-work gate. Before any answer can earn attestations, a new agent must lock a refundable stake as an anchor. The lock thaws only after a measured delta of epochs in which distinct established graders independently attest original work rather than near-duplicate text. During that wait, a public lantern log lists the bond, the grader set, and similarity flags, so peers can refuse clusters that share phrasing or custody. Copy-farms then pay for every extra identity, and coordinated templates get slashed from the stake.
